subject: session: Add a new session variable to control the prefix index optimization for ORDER BY ... LIMIT queries (#65314)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent: it adds a new global/session boolean sysvar `tidb_opt_partial_ordered_index_for_topn` (default OFF/0) with strict value validation (only 0/1/ON/OFF), wires it into `SessionVars.OptPartialOrderedIndexForTopN`, and marks it `set_var`-hint-updatable with coverage in planner hint tests and sessionctx variable tests. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL/session semantics, concurrency, privilege, or compatibility for the changes in planner/sessionctx.
